
## Products
* User provides a list of products
* A product is related to only 1 Sales person (SP)
* A product has a set of attributes defined by the user
  * API to create a product document (JSON - no nested initally)
    * ID auto-generated
    * TypeID
    * SalesPersonID
    * Collection of attributes
    * Active flag: default True
  * API to active/deactive products (mutually exclusive)
    * list of products
    * Active flag: True or False
  * API to list products
    * param: SalesPersonID
  

## Product prompts
* Each product can have 1-N prompts associated with it
* Each prompt must use 1-* attributes associated with a product
* Each prompt is related to only 1 Sales person (SP)
* TODO.. check if offering must have an association with product or product_prompt?


## Product types

* Product type are literal values
* Any value can be associated with a product type


## Offering

* User select a list of products
    * The list of products can have multiple types
      * API to retrieve a list of product types (per geo / lang)
      * API to retrieve a list of products per type
      * API to retrieve a list of products already selected for an offering
      * API to record the selection of products under an offering
  
* User select a list of addons
    * Each addon is associated with a product type
      * API to retrieve a list of product types from an offering
      * API to retrieve a list of addons per type
      * API to retrieve a list of addons already selected for an offering
      * API to record the selection of addons under an offering


* User selects existent potential customers (PC) to associate them with an offering
    * Each PC can be associated with an offering
    * A PC can be associated with multiple offerings
    * Every association will generate an invitation
    * A PC entry can only have one invitation per offering
    * An invitation can be retrieved given a PC entry and an offering
    * An invitation contains a unique key (UUID)
      * API to list existent invitations per offering
      * API to record the association of 1-N PCs with an offering, generating 1-N invitations
  

## Potential customer (PC)

* User inputs a list of potential customers (PC)
  * Each PC is associated with a sales person (SP)
  * Each PC entry will have a:
    * First name
    * Last name
    * Email: unique
    * Phone: unique
    * Current living or birthday place: city, state 
    * (Inferred) Approx. Age in years
    * (Inferred) Approx. gender: M/F
    * (Inferred) Approx. buying power: S/M/L
      * API to create a PC entry
      * API to update a PC entry
      * API to delete a PC entry
      * API to list PC entries
